name: SolarConstraintSolver
description: Component 0. Evaluate direct sun at protected points with Context only and with Context plus Design, and report affected points and violations. Place two instances: one for the original DesignVolume, one to independently verify the optimized result.

inputParameters.name: ProtectedPoints
inputParameters.description: Points whose sunlight must be evaluated. Accepts Grasshopper points, a Rhino Guid, an ObjRef, a RhinoObject or a Rhino Point.

inputParameters.name: DesignVolume
inputParameters.description: The proposed design volume evaluated as a separate obstruction role from ContextBuildings. Connect KeptVoxels here for the post-optimization verification instance.

inputParameters.name: ContextBuildings
inputParameters.description: Existing surrounding buildings used as the baseline obstruction. An empty list is a valid unobstructed baseline. Accepts Grasshopper geometry, a Rhino Guid, an ObjRef or a RhinoObject.

inputParameters.name: North
inputParameters.description: Project north direction. The horizontal XY component must not be zero.

inputParameters.name: Longitude
inputParameters.description: Site longitude in degrees. East is positive, west is negative.

inputParameters.name: TimeZone
inputParameters.description: UTC offset in hours. China is 8.

inputParameters.name: StartHour
inputParameters.description: Local clock hour to start the analysis window, 0 to 24.

inputParameters.name: EndHour
inputParameters.description: Local clock hour to end the analysis window. Must be greater than StartHour.

inputParameters.name: TimeStep
inputParameters.description: Sampling interval in minutes. Smaller values resolve continuous segments more precisely and cost more time.

inputParameters.name: MinimumContinuousMinutes
inputParameters.description: Shortest continuous direct-sun run that counts toward the qualified total, in minutes. Zero keeps the raw accumulated hours.

inputParameters.name: RequiredSunHours
inputParameters.description: Qualified sun hours a point must reach. No regulation value is hard-coded.

inputParameters.name: ImpactTolerance
inputParameters.description: Lost hours above this value mark a point as affected by the design.

inputParameters.name: Run
inputParameters.description: Set to True to calculate. Leave False while wiring the inputs.

outputParameters.name: SunHours
outputParameters.description: Final qualified direct-sun hours, one per ProtectedPoints item in the same order.

outputParameters.name: ViolationData
outputParameters.description: One record per affected or violating point, distinguishing existing-context violations from design-caused impact.

outputParameters.name: ConstraintData
outputParameters.description: Branch {i} holds the design-blocking events of ProtectedPoints[i]. Events are emitted only where Context is clear and the design blocks the sun.

outputParameters.name: Report
outputParameters.description: Status, inputs, statistics, warnings and errors. Connect a Panel and read this first after every run.
